text: The Sindh Resilience Project (SRP) is a government initiative in Pakistan, financed by the International Development Association of the World Bank, aimed at mitigating flood and drought risks in Sindh Province. It combines structural investments, such as strengthening Indus River flood embankments and constructing small dams, with institutional capacity building for disaster risk management. The project also includes a Contingent Emergency Response Component for rapid financing reallocation during crises.
